notes:
What's new in 0.9.222 (beta)
- Honest targets: the Optimal Lap and the Virtual Best can never claim more than 3% under your fastest real lap; a target built on unreliable lap distance is refused and your fastest real lap is used instead. Assetto Corsa recordings made before 0.9.218 are re-timed around the old freezes, so some targets are a little slower: Virtual Best Bathurst 2:06.888, Laguna Seca 1:22.212; Optimal Lap Laguna Seca 1:20.790 (was 1:14.329). ACC Monza: Virtual Best 2:11.364 from your real best of 2:14.890.
- ACC targets from your real fastest laps: when a session had slow out-laps, GOAT threw out your quickest ACC laps and counted the unfinished bits at the start and end of a recording as laps. Targets now use only laps the sim timed itself, and never a lap that drove fewer metres than the rest (a cut).

Also in this build
- Updates tell you when they did not install: if an update from inside GOAT fails, the header shows "Update to vX did not install" with the details, instead of quietly staying on the old version.
- Safer installs: an install that is stopped half way (a locked file, a cancelled install) puts your previous version back, so GOAT still starts; a newer version's leftover files no longer stay behind when you install an older one.
- In-sim ghosts are labelled: a session made only of Assetto Corsa ghost files or Coach Dave references says "in-sim ghost / reference, not your logged lap" in the lap table.
- GOAT Help, check my PC: on paid plans Help can ask to run one read-only check from a fixed list; nothing runs until you press Run check and nothing is sent until you press Send. The privacy filter on what Help keeps also removes compressed IPv6 addresses, whole vendor keys and a phone number at the end of a sentence.

Also in this build (0.9.219, never published on its own)
- Virtual Best from every session: building it from the Telemetry page or sr.py vbest uses all your sessions on that car and track (on Assetto Corsa it used one), keeps one Virtual Best per car and track, and is not rebuilt every time you open a session.
- Laps with lost time are not clean: a lap whose recording sat still for over a second is never used for a target.

Also in this build (0.9.218, never published on its own)
- Live readings no longer freeze: the overlay, phone dashboard, SMART and the recorder no longer stop for about 3 seconds every few seconds.
- Track maps the right way round: Assetto Corsa maps, road edges and the progress reel match the real circuit on every screen; a gap in the recording shows as a gap.
- Phone dashboard agrees with the sim: each lap shows its own time, the race table stays after the flag, a lap ended through the pit lane counts, a reset to the pits is not a lap.
- One set of corners everywhere: web map, overlay, Corners window and SMART use the same turn numbers and names; VIR has its official numbers again.
- Laps you can trust: Assetto Corsa lap times are the sim's own; your first lap after leaving the pits is timed line to line on every screen; laps are listed in the order you drove them; clean laps from earlier sessions count again.
- SMART hears you: a command after "sorry" or "cheers" still reaches it, short answers to its own question are heard, and it stays quiet when you think aloud in a race.
- Corner Debrief is hidden while it is rebuilt into a single "next lap" card.
- Virtual Best uses only your real driving. Two targets were stitched across data holes and were too fast: VIR FF1600 1:20.335 → 1:31.545, Tsukuba Formula Vee 55.692 → 1:05.921.

Known issues
- Assetto Corsa laps recorded by ACTI (.ld): lap times can differ from the sim's by 0.01-0.08 s, and lap numbers start at 0 (QA-B02/B03).
- Laguna Seca: corners use GOAT's own numbering, not the official track map (D-061).
- Laguna Seca, Bathurst, Spa and the Red Bull Ring: laps recorded by ACTI and by GOAT still build two separate Virtual Best targets until the track names are unified.
- Assetto Corsa sessions recorded before 0.9.218 can show timing up to ~3 s off in Compare and the corner tree. A Virtual Best built from them can be up to ~0.6 s too fast, so live delta and SMART's lap call can read slower than you really are. Fixed in a coming release.
